g.text: Choose how you sound and look in Voice Rooms and Direct Calls. Your microphone audio is processed locally.
Adjust the level sent to other Members.
Enhanced uses local RNNoise; Standard uses WebRTC.
Reduces sound from your speakers returning through the microphone.
Compensates for microphones that are unusually quiet.
Closes the microphone below the sensitivity threshold.
Auto protects frame delivery; Text preserves readability; Motion prioritizes smoothness.
Play a short tone through the selected output device.
Enhanced RNNoise is unavailable; standard WebRTC suppression is active.
